GATED: exact churn rate + cohort curve (only "reactivations tied to sourcing cycles/seasonality" hedge language given), 24-month MRR trend, customer concentration, COGS breakdown (the 69% cost), live URL. result.moat: MEDIUM-LOW. Real vs. a from-scratch clone: 800 EU supplier feeds + 80M-SKU Amazon matching + 6 yr brand/community trust (Trustpilot 4.5, 202 referring domains) is months of work and can't be bought quickly. BUT the data is scraped from public retailer sites + Keepa-style pricing — not proprietary in origin; barrier is effort/maintenance, not access. It's a decaying "maintenance treadmill" (scrapers break, data rots without constant upkeep — the reason for the 40h load) layered on a more durable brand moat. A funded EU-capable incumbent (Tactical Arbitrage) could compress it.
key_risks: AMAZON PLATFORM DEPENDENCY (double): demand exists only if Amazon online-arbitrage stays viable, and Amazon is escalating brand-gating/reseller crackdowns (TAM under structural pressure); supply relies on scraping + Amazon SP-API/Keepa data that Amazon/suppliers can restrict or block. Deal-killer #6.
Suspiciously cheap 2x-annual multiple on a 6-yr SaaS strongly implies flat-to-declining revenue (24-mo trend is gated) - deal-killer #2 until disproven.
Low 31% margin smells like bought growth (Google+Meta ads) + heavy data-ops tax; if acquisition is ad-fed the margin and 'moat' are fragile.
Crowded mature category with a well-funded, EU-capable leader (Tactical Arbitrage $59-109/mo, plus SourceMogul/SellerAmp/BuyBotPro).
Owner-as-product: two co-founders departing; moat upkeep may be load-bearing on them (deal-killer #8).
Churn hedged with 'reactivations tied to sourcing cycles' language - possible seasonal churn masked by reactivations (deal-killer #3).
result.delegation_verdict: At $7,716/mo net this is the FIRST/only shortlist listing that clears the ~$4K/mo delegation threshold: after a ~$1.5-2.5K/mo VA+contractor-dev spend, ~$5-6K/mo net remains, so delegation is genuinely affordable here (unlike Candidates A/B/C where a VA erased all profit).
